name: See-Thru
summary:
# See real art. In your real space. Before you commit to anything.
See-Thru lets you experience artwork the way it's meant to be seen, on your wall, in your room, at true scale.
Browse a growing collection of original artwork from independent artists around the world. Each piece can be placed directly into your physical space in augmented reality, so you can see exactly how a painting looks above your couch, in your hallway, or in that awkward blank wall you've never known what to do with.
